يمتنعا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَنِعَا (yamtaniʕā) /jam.ta.ni.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# يُمْتَنَعَا (yumtanaʕā) /jum.ta.na.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
